newsitem.title: USA: House Leader Armey sees capital gains cut support.
newsitem.headline: House Leader Armey sees capital gains cut support.

text.p: House Republican Leader Dick Armey said Tuesday he was impressed by support that both Republicans and Democrats expressed at talks with President Clinton for a cut in the capital gains tax.

At a news conference shortly after Clinton's meeting with leaders of both parties, Armey said: "I was impressed and pleased with the degree of positive reaction to the possibility of doing something on capital gains reduction from both sides of the aisle."

He said he had had been encouraged by hearing strong signs of support for a capital gains tax "from other members of Congress that I had not expected to hear voicing that support." He said he was referring to Democrats.
